scope: source package and lab structural metadata; production not inspected in this documentation task
limitations: Named PHP definitions are tokenized without executing them.
Call edges are lexical: dynamic callbacks, inheritance, variable receivers and reflection need runtime/source follow-up.
SQL catalog is source expressions, not an exhaustive reconstructed runtime query trace.
Controller methods are declared candidates; dispatch aliases and runtime ACL may restrict reachability.
JS data are lexical hints, not a complete JavaScript AST/call graph.
Lab IDs are examples of the actual copy, never portable constants.
Comments and catalogue descriptions are intent, not proof of feature execution.
